question: What is the meaning of waste materials in relation to materials property?
description: Waste materials refer to materials or building products that have reached the end of their useful life within a building. In relation to materials property, waste materials signify the loss of value and functionality of materials when they are no longer accessible, functional, or attractive for reuse or recycling. This highlights the importance of maintaining materials' value throughout their lifecycle to minimize waste generation and promote a circular economy.
